headline: Rising Electricity and Fuel Costs Accelerate Solar Adoption in Nigeria
summary: Nigerian businesses are shifting to solar installations to mitigate rising power tariffs and elevated diesel generation costs. Grid reliability issues continue to drive commercial adoption of off-grid solar equipment.
why: Nigeria's commercial solar market is expanding rapidly as commercial users seek alternative power sources to bypass national grid failures.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Transitioning commercial power to solar reduces business exposure to grid blackouts and fuel price volatility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
